title: Review: fix review findings KITH-0kl5 (P2/P3)
notes: Round 9 review: 1 real finding (P2 task: missing test for disconnect-while-blocking scenario), 4 confirmations of correct decisions. Confidence: 92% chance of no missed bug. The select! change is mechanically correct — live_tx.closed() semantics are right, cancel-safety under disconnect is safe, is_closed() secondary check is still valid. Uncertainty: tokio::select! pseudorandom branch selection under simultaneous ready is documented behavior and the consequence (discard event for disconnected client) is correct; however the interaction with a Lagged+continue loop iteration has not been exercised by any test. The missing test is the only real gap. Not bikeshedding: the missing test covers the exact scenario this commit was introduced to fix.
